model: complete historical SI six-state PG, variant=1; NOT tabulated educational model
method_qualification: GM_EKF is Gaussian-mixture moment-matched EKF, not a replication of Hu et al. DDR-EKF. MHE5 is finite-budget constrained MAP MHE, not a replication of Schiller-Mueller stability theorem.

mhe.arrival: causal EKF posterior at left boundary

controls: same recovered ThesisNMPC, p=57 m=6; thermal penalty QR=0 or 1000 for closed-loop, never described as hard constraint
plant_integration: existing advance/plant_segment with exact event splitting, RK4 substeps<=0.0025 h
freezing: Q_HIST R_HIST P_HIST and controller settings from base source; no test-set retuning; same integration for all estimators
pairing: input noise, base Gaussian measurement noise, contamination masks and magnitudes shared by all methods within scenario/replicate; SHA256 recorded
test_policy: all scheduled failures retained; no silent exclusions; bootstrap intervals exploratory with 8 replicates
plant_mismatch: none in primary campaign; separate future factor, not mixed with sensor robustness
no_truth_access: only evaluator uses truth; observers receive commanded inputs and thermal measurements
run_scope: 320 scheduled episodes: 3 scenarios, two noise conditions, four methods, eight seeds, one open-loop or two thermal-penalty choices
safety_scope: synthetic offline simulations; no physical controller action
